plugins.name: webcam-builtin
plugins.title: Built-in Camera
plugins.description: Registers the printer's built-in MIPI camera as a Moonraker [webcam] entry, so Fluidd and Mainsail show it alongside any other configured camera. WebRTC stream from /webcam/webrtc, JPEG snapshots from /webcam/snapshot.jpg. Requires the Camera HW Accel plugin to actually serve those URLs.
plugins.tagline: Show the built-in MIPI camera in Fluidd & Mainsail.
plugins.author: bespoked

config.label: Camera name in Fluidd/Mainsail
config.hint: Whatever you want it called in the UI: Built-in, Toolhead, Side, etc.

plugins.name: webcam-usb
plugins.title: USB Camera
plugins.description: Registers an external USB camera as a Moonraker [webcam] entry. WebRTC stream from /webcam2/webrtc, JPEG snapshots from /webcam2/snapshot.jpg. Requires the Camera HW Accel plugin to actually serve those URLs.
plugins.tagline: Show the external USB camera in Fluidd & Mainsail.
plugins.author: bespoked

config.label: Camera name in Fluidd/Mainsail
config.hint: Whatever you want it called in the UI: USB, External, Bed View, etc.

collections.name: double-camera
collections.title: Double Camera
collections.description: Two camera views of the same print, set up in one install: the printer's built-in camera and a USB camera you plug in yourself. Includes the hardware video acceleration, so both streams are encoded on the printer's video chip instead of its CPU. Both cameras appear as their own tile in Fluidd and Mainsail.
collections.tagline: Built-in camera plus a USB camera, both accelerated.
collections.author: bespoked

collections.name: single-camera
collections.title: Single Camera
collections.description: Everything you need to watch a print with the camera the printer already has. Installs the hardware video acceleration and the built-in camera tile together, so the camera shows up in Fluidd and Mainsail and the encoding runs on the printer's video chip instead of its CPU. Start here if you only want one camera.
collections.tagline: The built-in camera, working, in one install.
collections.author: bespoked

collections.name: watch-and-control
collections.title: Watch and Control
collections.description: See the print and drive the printer, from any browser. Installs the built-in camera with hardware video acceleration, plus the Remote Screen mirror, which puts the printer's own touchscreen in your browser and sends your taps back to it. Both the camera and the screen show up as tiles in Fluidd and Mainsail, so you never have to walk over to the machine.
collections.tagline: The camera and the printer's own touchscreen, in your browser.
collections.author: bespoked

collections.name: watch-and-control-plus
collections.title: Watch and Control Plus
collections.description: The full remote-eyes setup. Two camera views (the printer's built-in camera and a USB camera you plug in), hardware video acceleration so both streams stay off the CPU, the Remote Screen mirror that puts the printer's touchscreen in your browser and sends your taps back, and Timelapse, which turns the print into a video you can watch afterwards. Everything appears in Fluidd and Mainsail with no manual setup.
collections.tagline: Two cameras, the printer's touchscreen, and a timelapse of every print.
collections.author: bespoked
